english.title: Neglect to deliver expired hackney carriage licence or badge to Transport for London
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being a person to whom a licence had been granted under the London Hackney Carriages Act 1843, wilfully neglected for three days upon the expiration of that licence, to deliver it and the badge relating thereto to Transport for London
english.legislation: Contrary to section 18 of the London Hackney Carriages Act 1843.
